newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: RUGBY UNION-LIONS DRAW WITH NORTHERNS IN HOME DERBY. [CORRECTED 08:30 GMT 13/4]
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-LIONS DRAW WITH NORTHERNS IN HOME DERBY. [CORRECTED 08:30 GMT 13/4]

text.p: Gauteng Lions escaped with a 16-16 draw against Northern Transvaal in the Super 12 tournament on Saturday thanks to a last-minute try from Springbok fly-half Hennie le Roux.

Le Roux drove over the line from a short penalty and, with scrum-half Johan Roux converting, the former Super 12 leaders were able to breath a sigh of relief (corrects to show Gauteng Lions are "former" Super 12 leaders).

The Lions had been expected to thrash the revamped Northerns line-up at Ellis Park but the visitors from Pretoria put four successive defeats behind them to produce a compelling defensive pattern which the Lions were unable to break down.

In fact Northerns were unlucky not to take four points for the win, having outscored their opponents by two tries to one. Springbok left wing Jacques Olivier rounded off a brilliant break by centre Andre Snyman in the last minute of the first half and full-back Graham Bouwer punished the Lions for losing the ball forward at a ruck in the 51st minute.
The Lions had only themselves to blame with full-back Gavin Johnson missing four out of five kickable penalties in the first half before handing over the duties to Roux, who kicked three out of four.
Ahead 9-8 at halftime, the Lions ran out of ideas in the second half. Bouwer's try seemed to sap the energy of the home side but they were given fresh impetus by Roux in the last 10 minutes.

The scrum-half kicked ahead to set up a ruck in the last minute and when Puma prop Roberto Grau was stopped just short of the line Northerns were penalised for killing the ball. Roux and le Roux did the rest to send a 37,000 strong crowd home relieved, if far from happy.

Gauteng Lions - Gavin Johnson; Dawie du Toit, Japie Mulder, Joe Gillingham (Riaan van Jaarsveld, 66), Jannie van der Walt; Hennie le Roux, Johan Roux; Andre Vos, Ian Macdonald, Warren Brosnihan, Hannes Strydom, Kobus Wiese (captain), Kapstok van Geuning (Roberto Grau, 67), Chris Rossouw, Balie Swart.

Northern Transvaal - Graham Bouwer; Casper Steyn, Andre Snyman, Kosie van Vuuren, Jacques Olivier; Boeta Wessels (Frikkie Spangenberg, 62), Joost van der Westhuizen; Adriaan Richter (captain), Jannie Brooks, Nicky van der Walt, Wium Basson (Johan Otto, 56), Krynauw Otto, Piet Boer (Wessel Roux, 59), Henry Tromp, Lourens Campher.
